newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian rubber market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian rubber market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Malaysian rubber market is closed on Monday for a Hindu festival. It reopens on Tuesday.
On Friday, rubber prices ended firm after some latex short-covering for the Chinese market in early trading.
But business was thin, with consumer demand staying weak despite a late rebound in Tokyo futures.
At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board qouted December RSS1 buyer at 321 cents a kg, unchanged from Thursday. December SMR 20 was half cent higher at 310.50.
